annotations.title: Find a songwriter by IPI name number

description: Use when the user has an IPI name number (up to 11 digits, often written without its leading zeros) and wants to know which songwriter holds it. Returns the person or persons holding the number, each with a person ID and person_url; use get_songwriter for one person's details. `none` means no person here holds it: it may be a publisher's number, or one whose registrations have not been grouped.
name: songwriter_by_ipi
title: Find a songwriter by IPI name number
